architectural_notes: Profile and header avatar data source of truth is Firestore document users/{uid} (fields: name, email, photoURL); do not read these from Firebase Auth.

Scope constraint: modify only existing My Profile page and header avatar data fetching/binding; do not change signup/login/admin dashboard/user list/routes/navigation/UI layout/design/roles/approval logic.

existing_features.title: Update the existing My Profile page to display profile photo, full name, and email address strictly from the Firestore document at `users/{uid}` (fields: `photoURL`, `name`, `email`) and not from Firebase Auth user fields.

On the My Profile page avatar, implement a deterministic fallback: if `users/{uid}.photoURL` is missing/empty, do not attempt to load an image and instead show initials derived from `users/{uid}.name`.

Update the existing header (top-right avatar) to use Firestore `users/{uid}.photoURL` for the avatar image and fall back to initials derived from Firestore `users/{uid}.name` when `photoURL` is missing/empty; do not use Firebase Auth for any displayed profile fields.

Ensure the data used by the My Profile page and header avatar is fetched from Firestore `users/{uid}` as the single source of truth (reading only `name`, `email`, `photoURL` for binding) and that the UI updates to show Firestore data whenever it exists.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix My Profile page and header avatar to bind name/email/photoURL from Firestore users/{uid} (no Firebase Auth reads; fallback to initials when photoURL empty) without changing any other pages/routes/UI

projectName: Fix My Profile page and header avatar to bind name/email/photoURL from Firestore users/{uid}
